items.headline: America: Dhillon ne Civil Rights pad chhoda
items.detail: Trump prashasan ki pehli badi vidai — Attorney General ne 5 November ko Harmeet Dhillon ka istifa sweekar kiya; woh April 2025 se Civil Rights Division ki pramukh thi.
items.exam_angle: Midterm ke baad pehli badi vidai — America ki rajneeti aur nagrik adhikar ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: France: School bus haadse me do ki maut
items.detail: Lyon se Bourg-en-Bresse ja rahi bus ped se takra gayi; saat saal ki ladki aur 18 saal ke yuva ki maut, 16 ghayal, teen ki haalat gambhir.

items.headline: New Zealand: Chunav me koi vijeta nahi
items.detail: National ko 42 aur Labour ko 36 seatein mili; Labour ko vote share me halki badhat, lekin sarkar ka faisla 27 November ke aadhikarik natije par tika.
items.exam_angle: MMP chunav pranali aur hung parliament — loktantra ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Paraguay: Peña prosecutors ke saamne pesh hue
items.detail: Ueno Bank ke collapse par Senate ne Peña ko hataya tha; house arrest ke baad woh shanivaar subah Attorney General ke saamne pesh hue, Alliana naye rashtrapati ban chuke hain.
items.exam_angle: Mahabhiyog aur banking sankat — governance aur vittiya niyaman ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Presidencia de Ecuador, public domain (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: CENTCOM: Iran ki zameeni supply par rok
items.detail: America ki Central Command ne Task Force Iron Gate banayi hai jo Iran ki zameeni seemaon aur Caspian Sea se hathiyaron aur pratibandhit saaman ki aavaajahi rokegi.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanav me nakabandi ka vistaar — Hormuz aur samudri vyapar ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Israel: Eisenkot ko sarkar banane ka mauka
items.detail: Rashtrapati Isaac Herzog ne Netanyahu ke pratidvandi Gadi Eisenkot ko sarkar banane ka mauka diya; 67 sansadon ne unka samarthan kiya, Netanyahu ko 46 mile, aur Eisenkot ke paas 28 din hain.
items.exam_angle: Israel me sarkar gathan aur Knesset ki bhoomika — Madhya Purv ki rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Ronen Horesh / Knesset Archives, CC BY-SA 4.0 (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Qeshm-Jask: Hormuz kinare phir dhamake
items.detail: Iran ke sarkari media ke anusar Qeshm dweep aur Jask, Sirik aur Bandar Abbas me dhamakon ki awaazein suni gayin; wajah abhi saaf nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz jalmarg aur America-Iran tanav — antarrashtriya suraksha aur urja ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Sanaa: Hawai hamle me 27 ki maut
items.detail: Sanaa ke paas al-Shariya gaon par hawai hamle me Houthi-run health ministry ke anusar kam se kam 27 ki maut aur 36 ghayal hue; Houthis ne Saudi Arabia par aarop lagaya, Riyadh ne abhi koi tippani nahi ki.
items.exam_angle: Yemen grih yuddh aur Saudi-Houthi sangharsh — Madhya Purv ki suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump: Democrats ki jaanch ka aadesh
items.detail: Trump ne Justice Department ko Democrats ki jaanch ka aadesh diya, aarop hai ki ve mahaabhiyog ki dhamki dekar 'dabaav' bana rahe hain; unhone koi saboot nahi diya.
items.exam_angle: America me midterm ke baad satta santulan aur Congress ki nigrani — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Houthi: Riyadh airport, Aramco par hamle ka daava
items.detail: Houthiyon ne 6 missile-drone hamlo ka daava kiya — Riyadh airport aur Aramco sites nishane par; Saudi ne abhi pushti nahi ki, daave ki swatantra pushti nahi hui.
items.exam_angle: Paschim Asia sangharsh aur tel suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Kyiv: North Korea ki KN-23 missile ka istemal
items.detail: Zelenskyy ke mutabik prarambhik jaanch me ek key energy site par North Korea ki KN-23 missile mili; raat bhar chali 36 missiles me se sirf 4 roki gayin.
items.exam_angle: Russia-North Korea sainya sahyog aur pratibandh — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Krakow: Chauk par golibari, paanch ki maut
items.detail: Krakow ke Main Market Square par ek vyakti ne gaadi se andhadhundh golibari ki — paanch ki maut, ek darjan se zyada ghayal, aur police ne hamlawar ko goli maarkar giraftar kiya.

items.headline: Kyiv: Raat bhar missile-drones, bridge toota
items.detail: Russia ne raat ko Kyiv aur aas-paas par 36 ballistic missile aur 172 drone daage; Northern Bridge aur bijli-paani ki suvidhaon ko nuksan pahuncha, ek ki maut aur nau ghayal hue.
items.exam_angle: Abu Dhabi me mangalvar se Russia-Ukraine-America ki trilateral vaarta se pehle hamla — yuddh aur vaarta, dono ek saath.

items.headline: Hormuz: Ek hafte me 11 jahazon par hamle
items.detail: UKMTO ki haftavaar report ke anusar 6 November ko khatm hafte me Hormuz ke aas-paas 11 jahazon par hamle hue, jinme se teen doob gaye; aavaagaman sangharsh se pehle ke star se lagbhag 65% kam raha.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz jalmarg aur samudri suraksha — antarrashtriya vyapar aur suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran ne missile range ki seema hatayi
items.detail: Iran ke Revolutionary Guard ne apni ballistic missile par 2,000 kilometer ki khud ki seema hata li; pravakta ne kaha kshamata ko 'vyavhar me dikhaya jayega', maujooda missile ki pushti nahi ki.
items.exam_angle: Madhya Purv me tanaav aur Bharat ki urja suraksha — Hormuz marg par asar.

items.headline: Trump: Iran se takraav 'yuddh nahi'
items.detail: Trump ne kaha paanch mahine me koi ghayal ya mara nahi, isliye Iran ke saath jaari takraav yuddh nahi hai, aur kaha America ne Iran se tel nikasi me pragati ki hai.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran takraav par rashtrapati ka bayan — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Mexico: Police helicopter se goli, bacchi ki maut
items.detail: Tamaulipas ke abhiyojak ne pusht ki hai ki 29 October ko Matamoros me cartel ke khilaf karravai ke dauraan police helicopter se ki gayi golibari me America me janmi saat saal ki Aranza ki maut ho gayi; goli chalane wale adhikari abhi aazaad hain.
items.exam_angle: America-Mexico seema par police ki golibari aur nagrik suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran ne parmanu sthalon ke paas iodine baanta
items.detail: America ke hamle ke dar ke beech Iran ne apne parmanu sthalon ke paas rehne wale logon ko iodine ki goliyan baantni shuru kar di hain; The Times of London ki report ke anusar Pickaxe Mountain sthal par hamle ki aashanka hai.
items.exam_angle: Iran parmanu karyakram aur America se tanav — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran ka daava: Qeshm par US drone giraya
items.detail: Iran ki sena ne kaha uski vayu raksha ne Qeshm dweep ke upar America ka MQ-9 drone gira diya, aur sena pravakta ne chetavni di ki naya hamla hua to jawab ki koi seema nahi hogi.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz jalmarg aur America-Iran tanav — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Zaporizhia: Sahayata kendra hamle me 55 ki maut
items.detail: 2 November ko Komyshuvakha me sahayata baant-te samay hue hamle me mrityu sankhya 55 hui; pichle 24 ghante me malbe se nau aur shav mile, darjanon abhi lapata hain.
items.exam_angle: Manavtavadi kendron par hamla — yuddh kanoon aur nagrik suraksha ka mudda.

items.headline: White House ke paas hathiyarbhand vyakti giraftar
items.detail: America ki Secret Service ne White House ke paas ek chori ki gaadi me teen hathiyaron ke saath Ronny Yordrix Guanipa Chrinos ko giraftar kiya; usne kaha awaazein use Trump ko maarne ko keh rahi thi, DHS ke anusar ve hirasat me hai.
items.exam_angle: America me rashtrapati ki suraksha aur Secret Service ki bhoomika — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Qatar: America-Iran samjhauta vaarta jaari, khabar jhoothi
items.detail: Qatar ke media office ne kaha ki PM ke bayan ko online bigada gaya; dono paksh samjhote ki taraf kaam kar rahe hain aur madhyasthata jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: Paschim Asia me Qatar ki madhyasthata — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Ukraine ne Saratov refinery par drone hamla kiya
items.detail: Raat bhar ke hamle me Saratov refinery me aag lag gayi aur Oryol ki Proton factory par Neptune missile gira; Russia ne 411 drone rokne ka daava kiya.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh me oorja dhanche par hamle — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Beijing: Xi-Trump-Putin baithak par baatchit jaari
items.detail: Cheen ne pehli baar pusht ki hai ki woh Shenzhen me APEC shikhar ke kinare Xi, Trump aur Putin ki aitihasik tripakshiya baithak par baatchit kar raha hai; abhi kuchh tay nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: APEC shikhar aur teen badi shaktiyon ki tripakshiya kootniti — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.
